start_description: Native Corporation start with the supplied starter construction and 300 total Goo balls/material units. Permitted starts must offer constructionwise-equivalent opportunities; this declaration is community-reviewable, not a fixed coordinate or RNG requirement.
consumption_policy: All supplied material must be used in construction. Legitimate consumption by reinforcement or another permitted ordinary-game construction operation counts. Unused inventory or discarding balls does not count. This is not a graph-connectivity requirement.
